text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on modeling climate change impacts on forest carbon storage (vegetation and soil) in Switzerland. While it uses national-scale spatial implementation and multiple future scenarios, its primary objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. It simulates the dynamics of potential natural vegetation and carbon stocks under climate change using a dynamic vegetation model (LPJ-GUESS). LULC change (e.g., conversion from forest to other land covers) is not the central research question; the focus is on changes in carbon storage within forest ecosystems under different climatic futures, not on predicting spatial patterns of LULC classes.)
